Initial public release of phy-lock-file-auditor.

- Audits lockfiles for security and integrity issues across JavaScript (npm, yarn, pnpm), Python (poetry, pipenv), Go modules, and Rust (cargo).
- Detects:
  - Phantom dependencies (packages in lockfile but not in manifest)
  - Lockfile drift (manifest changed without updated lockfile)
  - Integrity hash anomalies (missing, malformed, or duplicate hashes)
  - Conflicting version pins for duplicate/nested packages
  - Yanked or unpublished package versions still pinned in the lockfile
- Pure local file analysis—no external API calls
- Generates a CI freshness gate command for automated checks
- Trigger via phrases like “lockfile audit”, “integrity hash”, “/lock-file-audit”, and more
